rules.rationale: A16 preserves the initial nxt_cn default, the ConnectivitySettingsManager API correction and the final A13 bst.country=CN expansion. The implementation keeps the A16 NetworkAgentInfo signature, Wear Bluetooth prompt exception and explicit global setting precedence.
rules.necessity: Required for China game network strategy on both OEM-labelled and country-labelled configurations.
rules.performance: Two system-property reads only when captive portal mode is evaluated, equal to the pre-fix A16 count because values are reused for logging.
rules.security: China configurations intentionally default to ignoring captive portal prompts, which can hide interception. A user/admin global setting still overrides the default.
validation_evidence: android_x86_64-trunk_staging-eng service-connectivity.com.android.tethering and FrameworksNetTests built with -j8; built dex contains bst.country and aligned jar SHA-256 3a2def1bc54eb15638986b929e8699d3d1906683f3374e787c37620aeda32a02.

rules.rationale: The A13 pragma is retained at the renamed A16 bpf/progs/dscpPolicy.c path so the bounded MAX_POLICIES loop is unrolled for verifier/load-time behavior.
rules.necessity: Required to avoid excessive or failed DSCP BPF program loading on the App Player kernel/verifier combination.
rules.performance: Improves load/verifier time at the cost of a larger BPF instruction sequence; packet-path matching semantics remain unchanged.
rules.security: No policy broadening, but unrolled instruction count must remain within verifier limits after future MAX_POLICIES changes.
validation_evidence: Target commit changes only the current DSCP policy loop with pragma unroll.

rules.rationale: This intermediate A13 patch hard-coded Ethernet to TRANSPORT_WIFI. The later authoritative eb7ce3064638 patch replaced it with BstFilterAppsService-controlled Ethernet/Wi-Fi presentation, defaulting to Wi-Fi on failure. A16 implements that final policy.
rules.necessity: The hard-coded intermediate form is not necessary and would remove the final configuration switch.
rules.performance: Avoids permanently forcing a single transport and preserves one bounded service query during capability construction.
rules.security: The final policy centralizes transport exposure in a privileged service instead of an unconditional module constant.
validation_evidence: A13 commit order and final A16 parseTransportType/shouldExposeEthernetTransport implementation were reviewed.

rules.rationale: A16 preserves both halves of the A13 patch: property-driven static IP/gateway/DNS configuration in EthernetConfigStore and Wi-Fi legacy presentation in EthernetNetworkFactory when bst.config.modify_network is enabled. Current dependencies and tests replace static property caching and old factory APIs.
rules.necessity: Required for host-managed guest addressing and applications that expect Wi-Fi rather than Ethernet APIs.
rules.performance: Property parsing occurs during config load/agent creation, not packet processing. Static addressing avoids DHCP but malformed values can delay or fail network bring-up.
rules.security: Properties control IP, gateway, DNS and network identity. They must remain privileged; invalid or malicious DNS values can redirect all guest traffic.
validation_evidence: Final A16 EthernetConfigStore contains the gated static configuration and EthernetNetworkFactory tests cover legacy Wi-Fi presentation.

rules.rationale: A16 queries BstFilterAppsService through the hidden ServiceManager reflection boundary and selects Ethernet only when isEtherNetType(system_server) is true; failures and null service default to Wi-Fi. Transport parsing is factored for the current tracker and covered by tests.
rules.necessity: Required to switch guest-visible transport between compatibility Wi-Fi and real Ethernet semantics without rebuilding.
rules.performance: One synchronous Binder query during network capability construction; no packet-path overhead. Service readiness can affect startup latency but failure is bounded and defaults safely.
rules.security: A privileged service controls system network presentation. Reflection does not widen Binder access, but service spoofing/readiness and fail-open Wi-Fi behavior require boot regression.
validation_evidence: Final A16 EthernetTracker has service null checks, exact service name and current transport validation; added unit tests cover default behavior.
